domain: DEATH-EVENT FINAL-QUARTER DISTRESS CONDITIONING (the evidenced Form-15 census used as an EVENT SET for the first time: the terminal quote-gap shape of the dying name conditions a sector-peer reaction book at the death arrival)
title: Terminal quote-gap distress conditioning: long sector peers after orderly evidenced deaths, short peers after gapped deaths, sector-residual event book on the death-inclusive cohort, entered STRICT_NEXT_BAR after the evidenced Form-15 arrival

mechanism_lineage.why_death_conditioning_carry_information: A Form-15 is a compelled, maximally low-salience disclosure: the issuer's counsel files it because deregistration is mandatory, nobody markets it, and the marginal sector allocator treats it as noise (limited attention). Its sector-level content - what the death says about credit conditions, channel health and distress contagion inside the industry - therefore impounds slowly into PEER prices after the stamp, a drift that is neither market timing (SPY) nor static sector beta (every leg is sector-ETF-hedged). The Form-15 census has been universe-only in V9; V12 is its first use as an event set, so the event instant itself is the untasted observable.
mechanism_lineage.why_the_terminal_quote_gap_shape_is_the_: The census measures, for every evidenced death, the calendar gap between the name's last EOD print and the evidenced Form-15 stamp (lag_days_last_quote_minus_death: p50 = -11 days overall; within DEAD_PRICE_CONFIRMED p50 = -11, p75 = -5, p90 = +6, p10 = -833). This gap separates two economically distinct death paths that the raw stamp alone cannot: ORDERLY deaths, where price discovery ran continuously to the legal end (idiosyncratic, anticipated single-name failure - the sector de-risked indiscriminately into it, so peers are oversold at the stamp and revert UP), and GAPPED deaths, where the print series died long before the stamp (trading halts, fraud, exchange delisting proceedings - events with systemic or contentious content, so peers face continued downgrade pressure DOWN). The conditioning observable is a calendar/microstructure COUNT (days since last print), not a price-return quantity: it is input-disjoint from the momentum shadow that killed the filing-event reaction space, and D2 measures the pooled rho to prove it rather than argue it.
mechanism_lineage.who_is_forced_to_trade_or_slow_to_react: Forced actor: index and mandate holders who must de-risk on a delisting event, and the dying name's own distressed sellers spilling into the sector print. Slow actor: the sector-level allocator who updates on headlines, never on Form-15s; the peer repricing therefore accrues after the evidenced stamp, inside the 20-bar window this book holds.

falsifiable_prediction: Post-stamp peer drift differs by terminal quote-gap class: in at least 2 of 3 folds S0_FOLD_1/2/3, the long leg (peers after ORDERLY events, gap_days <= 10) outperforms the short leg (peers after GAPPED events, gap_days >= 11) net of sector-ETF hedge and band costs, with (a) anchor expectancy > 0; (b) position PF >= 1.10; (c) folds positive >= 2 of 3; (d) populated-fold PF >= 0.8; (e) max fold MDD <= 0.15; (f) ETF positive share <= 0.50; (g) fold positive share <= 0.5; (h) anchor overall SPY-excess alpha > 0; (i) the sham-event control's same-sign alpha < 0.5x the anchor's - reproduction at >= 0.5x kills the family; (j) the visibility-cut neighbour supports with same-sign alpha; (k) D2 pre-selection gates pass: pooled |rho| <= 0.20 vs ALL THIRTEEN veto entries and anchor-vs-control identifiability (self-subsumption rho > 0.98 kills pre-score). Availability-lag mutation (P3, EXTENDED to Form-15): pushing a Form-15 arrival later shifts the event, its conditioning frame and its 20-bar window exactly one period and changes nothing else; a larger shift is an implementation leak and the arm is NOT_RUN fail-closed. REJECT and BLOCKED are successful outcomes.

cited_funded_clocks.observable: final-quarter distress window on evidenced Form-15 deaths (last min(60,n_pre) bars with date <= death)
cited_funded_clocks.use: the event set AND the conditioning measurement frame: every trigger event's terminal state is read at the evidenced arrival over the final-quarter frame; the neighbour's visibility cut reads the final-quarter liquidity ladder on this clock

clock.conditioner_definition: At each trigger event, let T = the evidenced Form-15 arrival date (P-1: the filing evidence IS the stamp; asserted dates never used). gap_days(e) = calendar_days(T - last_bar_date(e)) where last_bar_date(e) is the date of e's last EOD bar with date <= T and within max_age_days 800. Class: ORDERLY iff gap_days <= 10; GAPPED iff gap_days >= 11. The cut 10 is a single round number frozen at the wave SHA (it brackets the census DEAD_PRICE_CONFIRMED median gap of 11 days - the cut is declared, not searched). Census marginals bounding the split: lag buckets 0: 33, -119_-1: 1030, le_-120: 286 (pre-stamp-ending prints, 1349 events across all dead verdicts); the exact ORDERLY/GAPPED counts within the 1550-entity trigger set are computed at A9-F from the staged bars and reported - never tuned.
clock.event_semantics: STRICT_NEXT_BAR default: book windows contain bars with date > T; SAME_DAY_INCLUSIVE is NOT used anywhere in this family (declared ex-ante). Holding window k = 20 bookable bars (census-anchored: the >= 20-bar rung of the sham runnable-window census). Event legs force-flat at fold boundaries.
clock.staleness: every conditioning input (terminal bars, final-quarter ladder median) uses dates <= T and trailing windows within 800 days; no unbounded variant exists.
clock.p1_evidence: every event row carries its evidenced Form-15 stamp; census stamp block shows 0 missing, 0 cohort-vs-census mismatch; the conditioning never reads a date the evidence does not prove.

event_book_invariants_ack: P3 event-book invariants acknowledged and honored in full. (1) LAG MUTATION, EXTENDED: pushing a Form-15 arrival later shifts the event, re-forms the final-quarter conditioning frame and shifts the STRICT_NEXT_BAR book window exactly one period, changing nothing else - the sham control recomputes under the same mutation (P-3: controls recompute under any semantics change). (2) Window convention: STRICT_NEXT_BAR everywhere; no SAME_DAY_INCLUSIVE anywhere. (3) Dead-leg honesty: the death-inclusive price series is used for every conditioning read; peer legs exiting mid-window use exit-at-last-close with resolve_exit_band_bps (own band when tradable, C-rate 25 bps ceiling when UNTRADABLE/missing; the silent 10 bps fallback is forbidden per L-I3); zero-window events are counted and excluded-with-reason. (4) Survival-quote honesty: this family books NO survival quotes anywhere - its fills are ALIVE_EVIDENCED peer names and its conditioning reads pre-stamp bars of DEAD_PRICE_CONFIRMED names only; it is a death-event reaction family and claims nothing on the 219 survival names. (5) P-1 availability evidence absolute: only evidenced stamps enter.

arms.arms_note: exactly three arms per binding rule - anchor, neighbour, control. All arms run under evidenced semantics (P-1/P-3); the control recomputes under any semantics change.
arms.anchor: Two-class event book on the mapped-sector subset of the 1,550 DEAD_PRICE_CONFIRMED triggers. At each ORDERLY event (gap_days <= 10): LONG the peer basket - equal-weight all eligible ALIVE_EVIDENCED priced names in the same mapped SPDR sector, excluding the dying name - hedged SHORT the mapped sector ETF share (sector-residual leg). At each GAPPED event (gap_days >= 11): SHORT the peer basket, hedged LONG the mapped sector ETF share. Overlapping event windows aggregate into one daily book; events in the same sector and class on the same date share one deduplicated basket; gross cap 2.0; CASH absorbs imbalance; class imbalance per date is reported as a diagnostic. Claim: post-stamp 20-bar peer drift is UP after orderly deaths and DOWN after gapped deaths, net of sector beta.
arms.neighbour: Visibility cut (required SUPPORT, same sign): only trigger events whose dying name passes the frozen final-quarter liquidity ladder rung - per-entity median final-quarter dollar-volume >= 50,000 USD (census: 1,205 of 1,745 entities with final-quarter medians pass the 50k rung; pooled finalq bar dolvol p50 = 581,064 USD). The claim this tests: sector-level contagion content lives in VISIBLE deaths - names with real holders, real tapes and index membership - while ghost deaths (sub-50k terminal tapes) carry no sector information. A materially different cross-sectional cut from the anchor's (liquidity-visibility vs quote-integrity shape), not a parameter wiggle: if the anchor's spread exists only among ghost deaths, the contagion interpretation is withdrawn (declared support-failure, not a tuning opportunity).
arms.control: MANDATORY sham-event placebo (P3 lane2_control_mandate), verbatim census machinery: deterministic sector-matched host pairing - DEAD_EVIDENCED priced entities with evidenced death date matched to ALIVE_EVIDENCED priced hosts by cohort sector tag; within sector both sides sorted by CIK, dead[i] -> alive[i mod n_alive]; no fuzzy matching; sectors with zero alive hosts yield UNMATCHED (never guessed). Offset convention verbatim: offset_days = death_date(dead) - first_bar_date(dead); sham_date = first_bar_date(host) + offset_days. The sham book runs the IDENTICAL machinery with the host's sham_date as the event: the host inherits the paired dead entity's ORDERLY/GAPPED class label, the peer basket is the host's sector pool excluding the host, the same 20-bar STRICT window and the same hedge apply. Any alpha surviving under the sham is calendar/composition artifact, not death-event information. 671 UNMAPPED-SECTOR dead entities have NO host: they are excluded-with-reason IDENTICALLY from anchor, neighbour and control (trigger events without a mapped sector are dropped in all arms, preserving anchor-vs-sham comparability on the identical event subset) - never guessed; census counts on record: 1,098 mapped-sector pairs over 391 hosts, 671 UNMAPPED unmatched. RUNNABILITY PROOF (census): host-side clear windows at matched offsets w20 = 3,037,029 of 3,518,470 positions with 391/391 hosts holding >= 1 runnable window; anchor-side runnable w20 windows = 886 of 1,098 in-scope anchors. Kill rule (frozen): sham reproduces the anchor same-sign >= 0.5x on the identifying metric (per-event 20-bar peer-basket alpha vs risk-matched SPY, pooled) -> family DEAD.
arms.intended_correlation_profile_and_why_it_: anchor vs control: by construction the sham relabels event timing onto living hosts while preserving sector and class composition - declared expected pooled Spearman rho(anchor, sham) 0.00-0.10, per-date gate 0.30; measured at D2 before selection, never argued post hoc.

book_form.form: daily long/short sector-residual event book - book_form provision 2.1 INVOKED with frozen justification: the mechanism is sector-relative contagion (what the death says about the sector, net of the sector's own beta), so each event leg is hedged with its mapped SPDR sector ETF at construction time; the justification is frozen here before selection. The frozen exposure gates, the ETF-share gate and the SPY-excess gates apply unchanged to this form, and D2 novelty is measured on conditioning exposures.
book_form.costs: frozen band model verbatim, charged exactly once per fill, linear in fills, applied to booked PnL, no sidecar: research/assets/stocks/kernel_band_cost_v9.py - BAND_BPS = {A: 10.0, B: 15.0, C: 25.0}; band_of ADV63 >= 50,000,000 -> A, >= 10,000,000 -> B, >= 2,000,000 -> C, else UNTRADABLE; fill_cost_bps = abs(dw) * resolve_band_bps * cost_mult / 10,000. Stress rerun cost_mult 2.0 (20/30/50 bps per side) applied to booked PnL, reported alongside base. Fail-closed: a traded name without a computed band raises BandResolutionError (L-I3); exits use resolve_exit_band_bps (C-rate ceiling when UNTRADABLE/missing).
book_form.expected_cost_blend: fills land on ALIVE_EVIDENCED peer names only - a mixed-B/C cohort expected; blended base cost expected between 15 and 25 bps per side; fills, cost and booked PnL reported split by band for base AND stress. The dying names' own thin post-death tapes are NEVER filled in this family, so the census post-death p50 of 2,108 USD does not bind here.

failure_interpretation.control_ratio_ge_0.5_same_sign: the spread is a calendar/composition artifact of the event set, not death-event information - family dies; the pre-declared falsification outcome and a successful test (falsification-by-control cluster precedent).
failure_interpretation.neighbour_opposite_sign: the contagion reading does not require visible deaths - withdraw the visibility interpretation (support-failure, not a tuning opportunity).
failure_interpretation.folds_positive_lt_2_or_fold_positive_sha: the effect does not survive regime change - die.
failure_interpretation.spy_excess_fail: the spread is market/sector context, not incremental death-event information - die.
failure_interpretation.etf_share_gt_0.50: hedge leakage through book construction - die.
failure_interpretation.populated_fold_pf_lt_0.8: the book degrades to noise in some regime - die.
failure_interpretation.pre_selection_gate_fail: identifiability or novelty failure dies at D2 before any scored cell (INELIGIBLE_*); the cheap death, correctly taken.
failure_interpretation.availability_lag_mutation_fail: implementation leak - the arm is NOT_RUN fail-closed; no repair after PnL is visible.
failure_interpretation.thin_margin_rule: a survivor with knife-edge margins (< 0.05 PF margin, < 25% MDD headroom) is reported thin per P-2 regardless of pass count and treated as candidate-not-edge.

d2_predeclarations.a_conditioning_exposures_for_novelty_mea: The exposure vectors D2 will rank (Spearman, midrank ties, pooled over shared dates/universe) against ALL THIRTEEN veto entries at pooled |rho| <= 0.20, measured BEFORE selection: (i) the per-entity net leg weight of the anchor book per decision date (each event contributes its peer-basket weights); (ii) the raw per-event conditioner: gap_days class label mapped ORDERLY = +1 / GAPPED = -1 over trigger entities at their arrivals. Declared input-disjointness claims, each still rho-measured never argued: no price-return, semivariance, vol-level, WC-stock, Goodwill, accrual-flow, depletion-interaction or cash-level quantity enters any exposure (the nine V9 entries); sector is the neutralizer, not the exposure (sector-exposure form); the event is an evidenced Form-15 death, not a vintage/amendment filing, and the instrument is sector peers, not the filer (filing-event reaction event-time space); no amendment-process timing/cadence observable of any form enters (V10 timing form, V10 revision direction/breadth form, V11 cadence-latency form).
d2_predeclarations.b_anchor_vs_control_identifiability: Pre-declared before selection: expected pooled Spearman rho(anchor, sham) in 0.00-0.10 with per-date |rho| <= 0.30 on >= 90% of dates; measured from data alone (weights and class labels, no PnL). SELF-SUBSUMPTION KILL: if the sham control's per-period series correlates rho > 0.98 with the anchor's per-period series - i.e. the control is an implementation duplicate rather than an independent placebo - the family is killed pre-score (INELIGIBLE_CONTROL_UNIDENTIFIABLE), fail-closed.
d2_predeclarations.c_unmapped_671_host_gap_answer: The 671 UNMAPPED-sector dead entities have NO matched living host and are EXCLUDED-WITH-REASON identically from anchor, neighbour and sham control - never guessed, consistent with the P2 not_funded entry. Effect on this family: the trigger base shrinks from 1,550 to its mapped-sector subset (census scaling 1,098/1,769 implies roughly 960 triggers; the exact count is computed at A9-F from the deterministic rule and reported); anchor-vs-sham comparability is preserved because the exclusion is identical across arms. A sham that cannot run on the remaining base is a DESIGN FAILURE and kills the family pre-score - it is never counted as a pass.

drop_one_design: drop-one-symbol: rerun excluding the max-contribution peer symbol; survival requires after-drop expectancy > 0.
